scripts.db:setup: npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start:dev --workspace api" "npm run dev --workspace web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace api && npm run build --workspace web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace api && npm run lint --workspace web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace api && npm run test:e2e --workspace api && npm run test --workspace web
